title: fix(service-automation): a held connector instance logs its reason, and the connection refusal ends with one period
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X1nKKLC3bjaEUZnprGuxxth)_

Fixes #28939

Clause-②: no — log meta and one character of refusal text; no schema, accept set, error code or status moves.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:连接器实例因配置故障被挂起(平台自己拒绝服务的 `oauth2` 实例,例如 MCP 服务器走非回环地址的明文 http)时,启动日志那条 ERROR 现在在结构化字段 `reason` 里写明原因,不再写 `{"error":"undefined"}`;连接器连接接口(`GET`/`POST /api/v1/automation/connectors/NAME/connection`)返回的 400 拒绝句末尾从两个句号改为一个。
- 为什么改:运维排查被挂起的连接器时先看 ERROR 行,原来这里只有 "undefined",原因要到下一行 WARN 才有;管理员在界面和接口里看到的拒绝句以 ".." 结尾,这段文字会随版本发出。
- 风险与回滚:只动了日志字段和接口里多拼的一个句号。挂起判断、不重试的策略、WARN 行都没动;provider 抛错导致的挂起照旧把错误写在 `error` 字段(有对照测试)。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/services/service-automation/src/plugin.ts` 的 `failDegradedConnectorInstance`(ERROR 行的第三个参数)与 `connectionDoorSubject`(去掉多拼的句号);新测试 `src/connector-held-fault-log-reason.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/connector-held-fault-log-reason.test.ts`,预期 5/5 通过(其中 4 例在 main 上为红)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **The held-instance ERROR record carries its reason.** `failDegradedConnectorInstance` logged `describeThrownForLog(info.cause)` as the record's meta. The grant-refusal caller (an `oauth2` instance this server cannot serve) passes no thrown value, so the record rendered `{"error":"undefined"}`. The meta is now `{ reason: info.reason }` when there is no cause, the same sentence the husk stores as `degradedReason`, and `describeThrownForLog(info.cause)` when there is one (the provider-configuration-fault caller, unchanged).
- **The refusal sentence ends once.** Every reason `oauth2NotServableReason` returns already ends with a period. `connectionDoorSubject` appended another (`${notServable}.`), so all three sentences the door can answer ended "..": plain-http MCP server, endpoint not over https, no endpoints to discover. The door now passes the reason as it is. The constants are unchanged.
- **Unchanged.** The hold decision, the retry posture, the engine's WARN line (`degradedReason` meta), the error code `VALIDATION_ERROR` and the status `400`.

## Tests

- New `connector-held-fault-log-reason.test.ts` (5 cases), with a real `ObjectLogger` in JSON format and stderr captured, the way `connector-fail-cause.test.ts` reads records:
  - the held plain-http MCP instance logs exactly one ERROR record whose `reason` equals the instance's degraded reason, with no `error` field, and no stderr line contains `"error":"undefined"`;
  - CONTROL: a held instance whose fault is a thrown provider error (degraded first, then a reload meets an `include` the server does not list) still logs that error in `error`;
  - for each of the three refusals, `beginConnectorConnection` and `getConnectorConnection` reject with `status: 400`, `code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR'`, and a message equal to the stored degraded reason, not ending "..".

<details><summary>Measured on main, red first, ablations</summary>

- Main `135054eb`, probe against the built `dist/` (declared `qa_mcp_oauth_plain`, `provider: 'mcp'`, transport `http://192.0.2.2:41520/api/v1/mcp`, `authorization_code`): the ERROR record was `{"level":"error","msg":"[Automation] failed to materialize connector instance 'qa_mcp_oauth_plain' via provider 'mcp' (ADR-0097): a configuration fault, so the instance is no longer retried. Fix its declaration; an edit or a restart re-attempts it.","error":"undefined"}`; the door answered `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` ending `… accepted only to a loopback host..`. The stored `degradedReason` (and the WARN line that carries it) ended with one period, so only the door doubled it.
- Red first (new test on unfixed source): `4 failed | 1 passed (5)`: the log case (`reason` undefined) and the three door cases (message ends ".."); the CONTROL passed.
- Green on head: `5 passed (5)`.
- Ablation 1 (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, meta back to `describeThrownForLog(info.cause)`): `1 failed | 4 passed (5)`, the log case only. Restored: blob `38cbee7e` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Ablation 2 (door back to `${notServable}.`): `3 failed | 2 passed (5)`, the three door cases only. Restored: blob `38cbee7e` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- The test imports `./plugin.js` from `src/` (no `dist/` on its resolution path), so the ablations needed no rebuild.

</details>

<details><summary>Package suite, type check, lint</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation test`: `256 passed` files, `3286 passed` tests.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation typecheck`: exit 0.
- `eslint packages/services/service-automation --no-inline-config`: exit 0.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Another record has the same `{"error":"undefined"}` shape, outside this card's scope: `degradeConnectorInstance` (the backoff-retried degrade, not a held one) logs `describeThrownForLog(info.cause)`, and its "connection store unreadable" caller passes `cause: undefined`. Left alone per the order (diff kept to the held-instance branch and the constant); reported to the seat.
- The issue said the stored `degradedReason` also ended "..". Measured: it ended with one period; only the door's answer doubled it.

## Verification

Every local reading above is on head `7cfc27ff`. Derived gate families (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, reconciled with `--ran`): 61 derived, 60 run with exit 0, 1 not measured (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET: not every package has a `dist/` in this checkout). `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first answered exit 3 (its pinned fixture commit was outside the shallow clone); after `git fetch --depth=1` of that commit it answered exit 0 (48 cases). `check:nul-bytes`: exit 0. The repo-wide lint, `test:repo` and the full farm are CI's. Full dogfood not run: no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm. Overlap: none of the 24 open PRs touches `packages/services/service-automation/src/plugin.ts`.
